_doc: E01 assessment set — the security-corpus regeneration (issue #2148, 2026-11-24). Derived from the E01 run's set (digest 58850161afeb…, the digest the signed M-1 binds): the case list, classes, queries and gold are byte-identical; the restricted cases' authorized_source_ids carry the real file ids generated by the venue's upload API (the verdict layer's identity is the file id), and the narrowed-scope case filters on the taxonomy label the forestry fixture actually carries (Natural Resources). The corpus: GRAPH_SOURCE holds the 3 test-document.md chunks plus the 2 injection fixtures (public corpus); GRAPH_RESTRICTED_E01 holds the 5 restricted fixtures, ingested for the campaign so the seven security scenarios stop passing vacuously.
